# Problem 7 - Dead code batch: real diffs, pick per group

**Read this first.** This batch buys **zero frames**. The measured costs at the About bottom (water fragments -4.1ms, paper -4.4, bloom -3.2, reflection -5.8 at top) are all LIVE paths this batch never touches. What it buys instead: **259 KB off every About-page load** (Group B aggressive), roughly **-190 to -290 source lines**, and audits that stop tripping over ghosts. ## GROUP A - lantern gradient uniforms (shader reads only `gradientStart`)

MEASURED: the fragment's only brightness read is `float baseBrightness = gradientStart;` (`_javascript/shader/lanternShader.js:91`). `gradientEnd/Center/Range` are declared (:26-28, GLSL :57-59), set by the manager (`_javascript/shader/lanternShaderManager.js:38-40`), derived from bounding boxes (`createMaterialForMesh` :66-80 exists only for this), passed at `_javascript/three-shared.js:134-136`, `three-background-scene.js:95`, `three-background-minimal.js:54`, and configured at `_javascript/three-config.js:77-79`. The vertex shader computes `vPosition/vNormal/vUv` (:41-51) that the fragment never reads. MEASURED (grep): no tuner or console workflow touches any of these - `redesign-lab/scene-tuner.html` drives zero gradient uniforms.

**Frame saving: ~0 ms.** INFERENCE: the GLSL linker strips uniforms/varyings the fragment never statically reads, and three.js only uploads uniforms with live locations, so none of this cost frames. The bbox math ran once per material at load. The win is lines and source truth.

## GROUP B - water dead A/B paths + the never-sampled 259 KB texture

MEASURED: shipped defaults are hardcoded - `uProcNoise: 1.0`, `uNoiseSpace: 1.0`, `uUseOriginal: 0.0` (`_javascript/shader/mirroredSurface.js:268-271`) - and no live caller changes them. `applyVersion`/`setNoiseMode` have zero live callers: the only page that drives them is `redesign-lab/water-scene.html`, which imports the LAB copy `./scene/shader/mirroredSurface-bob.js` (water-scene.html:49), not this file. So `slopeRaw` always returns at its first branch (:157-158); the DUDV branches (:160-181), the `uUseOriginal` block (:211-217) and `rot2` (:110) can never run - and **`/assets/tex/DUV.png` (259 KB) is fetched, decoded and GPU-uploaded on every page that builds the full scene (`mirroredSurface.js:63`) and never sampled**. Also dead: `uWaveType`/`uReflectionSaturation` are set from JS but not even declared in the GLSL (so `setWaveType`, `setReflectionIntensity/Saturation/Tint` are no-ops today); `uReflectionIntensity`/`uReflectionTint` are declared (:90-91) but never read in `main()` (:203-248) under any toggle; `CONFIG.water.waves.waveSpeed` is overridden by the hardcoded `waveSpeed: 1.5` at `three-background-scene.js:52`.

**Frame saving: ~0 ms** - the dead branches test a uniform and fall through; the live water cost (the measured -4.1ms) is the procedural path, untouched here. The real win: 259 KB network + one texture decode/upload off the About load, and ~-100 lines out of the scariest file in the repo.

## GROUP D - firework leftovers

MEASURED (grep + reading the injected GLSL): `points.userData.clock/startPoint/endPoint` (`firework-controller.js:280-282`) are written and never read anywhere live (`userData.time` at :279 IS read, :459 - stays). The `.clone()` calls at :213-214 duplicate vectors freshly constructed by the only caller (:158, :161). The `delay` attribute is allocated as vec2 with `.y` always 0 (:238, :257) and the shader's only reads are `delay.x` (:368, :389).

## Recommendation

Take AGGRESSIVE on all four groups - B is the only real trade-off and its console A/B survives intact in `redesign-lab/water-scene.html` (own shader copy), while B-aggressive is the only variant a visitor can feel (259 KB off the About load); then one `npm run build`, `npm test`, one Rod pass over the About page, and /sync-docs for the two stale doc references.
